description: Update automated-QA settings: enable/disable, daily budget cap (USD), judge model (from the allowlist), and plain-English quality rules. When buyerRules is provided, a new immutable rubric version is published (built-in checks recompiled from the label schema + your rules stored verbatim). Advisory only — flags go to the review queue, never verdicts. Requires open-label:write scope.

buyerRules.description: Full replacement rule list; omit to keep the current rubric.

enforcement.description: Block/Acknowledge engage the real-time editor gate.

itemKey.description: Stable key for an existing rule.

ruleText.description: The rule, in plain English (stored verbatim).

dailyCapUsd.description: Daily LLM spend budget in USD (default 10).

editorGateEnabled.description: Real-time submit gate: Block/Acknowledge rules checked at submit time.

enabled.description: Whether automated QA runs on sampled submissions.

screenModel.description: Judge model override (must be in the allowlist returned by the read tool).

name: open_label_update_auto_qa
